summary: Round 3 for T15-05: the five acceptance criteria pass, and all five story checks passed in this session. Round 2's findings are resolved. The 404/501 split is implemented in windows.ts, compare.ts, matches.ts and model.ts. unavailable.test.ts pins the split with two manifests that differ only in listing windows/earth.json. Changes stay within apps/web/server/api, and the diff touches no config or schema files. I found no new defects.

The rule is documented at unavailable.ts:1-21. matches.ts:56-92 is the query schema. unavailable.test.ts:146-335 pins the 404/501 cases and the with/without windows/earth.json split. The 501 detail names WindowRecord or ComparisonRecord (unavailable.test.ts:316).

checks.criterion: AC2: family=model is refused and returns no distances on the mock bundle; any future model-family path carries the Predicted label and is refused while G5 is not PASS, pinned by a test

That function requires a model, model.g5 PASS and exactly one G5 PASS record in validation.json, and otherwise returns allowed:false. On allow it returns the PREDICTED_LABEL. model.test.ts:108-164 pins the refusal cases: no model, G5 not PASS, no G5 record and two G5 records. unavailable.test.ts:127-143 and the mock-bundle tests cover family=model.

I did not read the prd.json notes field at line 280 in full.

findings.claim: For a window or comparison id outside manifest.targets while a windows/<body>.json top-N file is listed, an unknown id gets a 501, the same answer a known id would get.
findings.evidence: windowSources returns every listed top-N file for any id. unavailable.ts:11-15 and unavailable.test.ts:266-272 document this as the orchestrator-approved rule for AC0, to be replaced by t15b-api once WindowRecord and ComparisonRecord exist. This is not a defect under the amended criterion.

resolution.reason: Not a defect, as the finding itself states. The orchestrator decided the round 2 escalation (codex-r2-1, claude-r2-1) for option (a) and amended AC0 in prd.json: 404 for an id that manifest.json rules out, and 501 naming the missing record schema for an id that only a listed file without an @terraluna/schema schema (windows/<body>.json, comparisons/<target_id>.json) could resolve, because PRD 8.5 and T15-01 AC3 forbid parsing those files. windows.ts:98-104 gives exactly that 501 when windowSources lists a top-N file, and the detail names the file and the missing WindowRecord schema. unavailable.ts:11-15 documents the rule, and unavailable.test.ts:266-335 pins it with two manifests that differ only in listing windows/earth.json (404 without it, 501 naming WindowRecord or ComparisonRecord with it). Telling an unknown id from a known one here would mean parsing a schema-less file, which the PRD rules out. The amended AC0 assigns the real 404 or 200 to t15b-api T15B-02, T15B-03 and T15B-05 once t0b-contracts adds WindowRecord and ComparisonRecord. No code change. All five story checks exit 0 at 0338a39 (web 457 tests, server/api 295, typecheck, make check, make test with pytest 404 and schema 157).
